insurer: Royal Sundaram General Insurance Co. Limited

room_rent.note: Product Benefits Table explicitly states 'No Room rent capping'

icu.note: ICU covered under inpatient care up to Sum Insured; no separate sub-limit stated

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment on standard claims. 50% co-pay applies during PED waiting period (years 2–3) up to ₹2L sub-limit. Voluntary co-pay of 5/10/15/20% available as optional cover for premium discount. Underwriting co-pay may apply for specific health conditions.

sub_limits.display: Ambulance ₹5k, Animal bite ₹5k, Evacuation ₹1L; PED interim ₹2L
sub_limits.note: Most benefits covered up to full SI. Sub-limits: Ambulance ₹5,000/hosp; Vaccination (animal bite) ₹5,000; Emergency domestic evacuation ₹1,00,000/yr. PED coverage in years 2–3 capped at ₹2L with 50% co-pay. No disease-wise sub-limits on standard inpatient claims.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt

ped_waiting.note: Base PED waiting period is 36 months. Optional ABCD Benefit add-on covers Asthma, High BP, High Cholesterol & Diabetes from 31st day onwards during PED waiting period.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 16 listed conditions including cataract, hernia, stones, joint replacement, etc. have 24-month waiting period

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded under standard exclusion Excl18. Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: 20% of Base SI added per claim-free year; max 100% of Base SI. No reduction on future claims once earned.

restoration.note: Flexi Reload restores 100% of Base SI once per policy year after exhaustion of Base SI + NCB. Available even for same illness/same insured. Not available for first claim in the year. Unused reload does not carry forward.

post_hosp.note: 90 days for inpatient and domiciliary; 30 days for day-care procedures

day_care.note: All day-care treatments covered up to Sum Insured; pre/post-hosp payable up to 30 days for day-care

domiciliary.note: Covered up to SI if treatment continues for 3+ uninterrupted days and hospitalisation was not possible

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to 100% of Sum Insured per policy year

organ_donor.note: Inpatient harvesting expenses for organ donor covered within recipient's SI; pre/post-hosp and screening of donor not covered

ambulance.note: Covers road ambulance and app-based cab to nearest hospital in emergency. Not applicable for day-care procedures.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, stem cell therapy, etc.) covered up to Base SI + NCB

consumables.note: Hospital Plus optional cover provides consumables + mobility devices up to ₹50,000/hospitalisation

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly excludes treatments outside India (E.2.13)

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years no look-back applied; claims not contestable except for proven fraud

grace_period.note: 15 days grace for monthly premium mode; 30 days for quarterly, half-yearly and annual modes

free_look.note: Not applicable for policies with tenure less than 1 year or on renewals

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI guidelines; waiting period credits transferred

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, external congenital anomaly, OPD treatment, treatments outside India, self-inflicted injury, alopecia, artificial life maintenance

optional_riders.display: ABCD Benefit (PED cover from day 31 for Asthma/BP/Cholesterol/Diabetes), Hospital Plus (consumables ₹50k), Voluntary Co-pay (5–20%), Health & Wellness Plus
